mapper.sql: from screening s join movie m on m.movie_id = s.movie_id join hall h on h.hall_id = s.hall_id join cinema c on c.cinema_id = h.cinema_id

s.*, m.title, h.cinema_id, c.cinema_name, c.address, h.hall_name, (select count(*) from screening_seat x where x.screening_id = s.screening_id and x.inventory_status='AVAILABLE') available,
(select count(*) from screening_seat x where x.screening_id =s.screening_id and x.inventory_status='HELD') held,
(select count(*) from screening_seat x where x.screening_id = s.screening_id and x.inventory_status ='SOLD' )sold
